subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster does not belong to that group?

(Note: The odd man out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter cluster)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e666a901f5bdc3d0ea1b8c1f65c09ca6e3fde92cb9873642297a266447832890.png] 

Logic follows here is that the first letter and the second letter are increased by 7.

Option 1) VCJ

Option 2) EMS

Option 3) AHO

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d3584be115524d4efd894e5b2c2da1c47eedc129e8ec99ffbcc06b9a96ec97c0.png] 

Option 4) HOV

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e5a295486d30ab96262b92b483d23c6422e564bd748c2bb2db114a4d3f1ed033.png]
